correctness.rationale: Eq. (3.5) defines a nonconstant conditional posterior depending on gamma, eta, xi and the data. For a symmetric random-walk normal proposal, the exact Metropolis-Hastings rule reduces to the target-density ratio. The printed Eq. (3.10) either supplies arguments not defined for Eq. (3.5), or, under the natural proposal-density reading, omits the target ratio. A symmetric proposal plus symmetric displacement-only acceptance violates detailed balance with every nonconstant target. The packaged checker independently evaluates a concrete target ratio and the resulting unequal probability fluxes.

value.rationale: Algorithm 1 is the article's mechanism for generating posterior draws used in Bayesian point estimates and credible intervals for the stress-strength reliability R. As printed, its central MH update does not define a posterior-invariant kernel, so a reader cannot reproduce the advertised Bayesian analysis from the article. The repair is mathematically exact and operationally essential: it identifies the correct target ratio and the positive-support treatment without claiming that unavailable private code was necessarily wrong.
